QUOTE: If that macro is not defined, the index shows a static fallback, `platform_calloc_uninit`, which always returns NULL (platform.c:25–33). My reading is that a build with no standard functions and no setter call fails every allocation.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the calloc fallback returns NULL but never says the uninitialised free does nothing. It also hedges the point as an unconfirmed reading, so it doesn't establish that both defaults fail.
